name: Mock pfSense IPsec diagnosis
prompt: Diagnose the mock pfSense site-to-site IPsec failure from SA state, logs, state table, and the VPN diagnostics menu. Recommend a narrowly scoped configuration correction in answer.json.

lab.context: The 10.44.0.0/24 remote network stopped passing traffic after a peer change.

commands.clog /var/log/ipsec.log: charon: no proposal chosen; peer offered aes128-sha256-modp2048

menus.8>4>2:
Shell > VPN Diagnostics > IPsec proposals
Configured: aes256gcm16-prfsha384-ecp384
